Remark
[Dimensionless-radius form of Shi's estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0266 ↗ thm:chow-ii-shi-local-first-derivative-estimate 1. ch14:14.12\group Local Curvature Estimates

If $\gamma \le r\sqrt K\le \beta $, the maximum-principle polynomial in the proof is dimensionless after dividing $H$ by $K^4$; consequently $|\nabla \operatorname {Rm}|\le C(\alpha ,\beta ,\gamma ,n)K/\sqrt t$.
